'''Tak''' was a [[Coruscanti]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[con artist]] who was a [[Slavery|slave]] working at the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] of [[Kessel]] by [[10 BBY]].

==Biography==
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[con artist]], Tak robbed the elderly<ref name="Solo Official Guide">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> on his [[homeworld]] of [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars NE" /> At some point he crossed the line when he attempted to rob the [[Unidentified Princess of Kessel|Princess]] of [[Kessel]], something that led him to be sent to work as a [[Slavery|slave]] at the [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] of Kessel as punishment. However, even as a slave, Tak swindled his way to try and get easier work shifts.<ref name="Solo Official Guide" />

In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date Note">The timeline provided in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' places [[Han Solo]]{{'s}} [[Kessel Run]] nine [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. As that film takes place in [[19 BBY]], we can deduce that the mission to [[Kessel]] and the subsequent Kessel Run took place in [[10 BBY]].</ref> Tak was present working at the mines when the [[Crimson Dawn]] henchman [[Tobias Beckett]] and [[Beckett's gang|his gang]] [[Raid on Kessel|came]] to talk with the [[Pyke]] [[capo]] [[Quay Tolsite]], who supervised the mine. However, the deal was in reality an assault organized by [[Dryden Vos]], Crimson Dawn's leader. After [[Qi'ra]] [[Death|killed]] Tolsite by using [[Teräs Käsi]], Tak and the other [[miner]]s were freed from imprisonment and escaped to the surface for freedom.<ref name="Solo" />

[[Standard decade|Decade]]s later, Tak was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', a survival guide written by [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[DK-RA-43]].<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
With the absence of [[C-3PO]], Tak was played by ''[[Star Wars]]'' veteran [[Anthony Daniels]] in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. Tak's role follows the tradition in having Daniels appearing in every film of the franchise and references C-3PO's concern of "being sent to the spice mines of Kessel or smashed into who knows what" from the first scene in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
